about.title: Turning complex business into product structures teams can act on
about.lead: I mostly work on system experiences shaped by business rules, multi-role collaboration, and real execution constraints rather than isolated screens.
about.body: Across dental care and digital operations, I often sit between design, product, and frontline teams to turn requirements into structures that are understandable, actionable, and deliverable.
about.point.1.label: Role
about.point.1.title: Connecting design, business, and delivery
about.point.1.body: I do more than ship UI. I help teams clarify the problem, align on it, and move it forward.
about.point.2.label: Problem Type
about.point.2.title: Strong in high-constraint, multi-role systems
about.point.2.body: My work often sits in process-heavy environments where business logic and user experience have to be balanced together.
about.point.3.label: Approach
about.point.3.title: Structure first, then coordinated action
about.point.3.body: From requirement analysis to delivery communication, I care whether a team can act consistently from the design.
experience.title: From design execution to complex business collaboration.
experience.intro: This section is not a company timeline. It shows the three stages through which I built my current way of working.
experience.item.1.title: Building judgment through execution quality
experience.item.1.body: I started with interface and visual execution in digital projects, building strong instincts for information hierarchy, interaction clarity, and output quality.
experience.item.2.title: Defining problems inside real workflows
experience.item.2.body: In dental care and service operations, I began working continuously on screening, membership, payment, and imaging systems with layered business constraints.
experience.item.3.title: Designing with collaboration and rollout in mind
experience.item.3.body: My focus now includes requirement analysis, cross-role alignment, and delivery conditions so design becomes a tool for moving the business forward.
portfolio.title: Main Episode: Featured Work
portfolio.intro: Start with the lead storyline, then use two side episodes to expand workflow governance and specialist collaboration.
portfolio.item.1.title: Member automation and service continuity
portfolio.item.1.body: Membership, coupons, payments, and billing were disconnected, leaving frontline teams to improvise and finance to reconcile manually.
portfolio.item.1.reframe: I reorganized card, discount, payment, and reconciliation rules, then moved frequent member workflows into system automation.
portfolio.item.1.result: The result was faster frontline handling and a shift from full manual reconciliation to exception-based checking.
portfolio.item.2.title: Orthodontic screening and status management
portfolio.item.2.body: Orthodontic pre-management relied on review events and offline coordination, leaving screening, conclusions, and follow-up disconnected.
portfolio.item.2.reframe: I turned recommendation rules, re-screening logic, orthodontic status, and multi-role collaboration into one continuous system flow.
portfolio.item.2.result: The result was a traceable funnel from recommendation to appointment, turning pre-management into a continuous mechanism.
portfolio.item.3.title: PACS interpretation and AI-assisted review
portfolio.item.3.body: Pure manual image reading lacked system traceability and quality control, making utilization and diagnostic behavior hard to track.
portfolio.item.3.reframe: I first turned image reading into a structured record flow, then built a human-AI loop around AI marks, doctor review, and feedback recovery.
portfolio.item.3.result: The result improved detection while bringing image reading, chart sync, and management tracking into one closed loop.
